previous.changeLog:
Garage widget repositioning. The hangar percentile bar can now be moved: Ctrl+drag it directly, or use the numeric X/Y steppers in settings, plus a Follow Carousel toggle. Includes a reset-to-default command.
Saved settings survive upgrades. This release migrates values across the bump, so your configuration is preserved (Aslain ModsSettingsAPI; fail-soft to a fresh install).

current.changeLog: In-battle MoE projection should now be closer at every mark threshold.

previous.changeLog: Fixed an issue where saved Camo Selector outfits with stale projection decal slot data could trigger a Wrong slotId for current outfit error when loading. Style projection decals are now restored more defensively and invalid saved projection decal slots are ignored.

current.changeLog: Persisted local customization IDs across restarts, cleaned deleted assets from saved outfits, improved JSON save reliability, recalculated local-asset usage automatically, and repositioned the overlay button when the interface changes.
